svg.title: The Desk — engine architecture and slimmed output contract for Faktor
svg.desc: Six-step black-box engine. Faktor consumes only verdict + copy + match identity. Model internals stay inside The Desk.
svg.text: The Desk — engine architecture & output contract
Black-box service for Odds Primer. Faktor consumes a slim JSON contract: verdict + copy. Model internals stay inside.
Pipeline · everything inside the dashed border is The Desk
market prices skip the model — feed the verdict step directly
Output contract · what each match JSON looks like
// the editorial — render verbatim, do not interpolate
side, market_venue, price, edge_pp all set.
UI: full verdict block + venue CTA.
e.g. Back France on Polymarket at −180
UI: "no edge" block, no CTA, no link.
e.g. Tunisia v Australia · markets agree
UI: "skip" block, no link. Named opinion.
e.g. Skip Germany v Japan · line short
Refresh cadence · three speeds in The Desk
Model — weekly · daily T−5 · hourly T−3
Faktor doesn't track which speed updated — just polls index.json /60s and refetches whatever's changed via ETag.
Fundamentals only · weekly model + verdict refresh
